verdict.rationale: The integrations directory lists first-party Datadog (create incidents from monitors), Grafana (attach alerts to incidents) and Sentry (link errors to incidents) integrations, and the On-call page claims over 40 alert sources plus custom HTTP sources. However, Prometheus and CloudWatch are never named, and the evidence consists only of one-line directory blurbs rather than setup documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of Prometheus and CloudWatch integrations, documented setup guides for each integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
